تتعرقبين (form IIq)
# تَتَعَرْقَبِينَ (tataʕarqabīna) /ta.ta.ʕar.qa.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# تُتَعَرْقَبِينَ (tutaʕarqabīna) /tu.ta.ʕar.qa.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
